criteria.name: Mermaid Syntax & Render Validity
criteria.description: The Mermaid block must parse cleanly using @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli v10+ without warnings or errors. Rendering to SVG/PNG must produce a valid, non-corrupted image. Any use of deprecated syntax or external graphviz dependencies not listed in the project config causes immediate failure.

criteria.name: C4 Mandatory Container Presence
criteria.description: Exactly 7 mandatory containers must be present in both the mermaid AST and the narrative: Mobile App Frontend, Hermes Agent, Phomemo Printer Interface, Markdown Data Storage, QR Code Generator/Service, Gardener (Person), Telegram Service. Exact node ID or display name match is required. Omission, duplication, or misspelling results in failure.

criteria.name: Container Narrative Structure & Depth
criteria.description: Each of the 7 containers must have a dedicated H3/H4 section. The narrative must contain 3-5 sentences explicitly covering: Primary Responsibility, Input Data/Triggers, Output/Downstream Effects, and Failure/Graceful Degradation handling. Sentences must be grammatically complete and free of placeholders like 'TBD' or 'N/A'.

criteria.name: PRD Traceability & Citation Format
criteria.description: Every container narrative must cite at least one [FR-X] and one [NFR-X] requirement. All cited IDs must exactly match the authoritative PRD index. Citations must appear inline. Missing citations, invalid ID formats, or citations referencing non-existent PRD sections cause failure.

criteria.name: Connector Label Standardization
criteria.description: Every arrow/edge in the diagram must have a label. Labels must follow a strict Verb-Noun pattern (e.g., POST-qr-request), be ≤ 8 words, contain no special characters, and appear verbatim in the corresponding container narrative. Unlabeled, incorrectly formatted, or uncited connectors cause failure.

criteria.name: Markdown Document Structure
criteria.description: File must use valid YAML frontmatter (title, sprint: 2, author), H1 for document title, H2 for each container section, H3/H4 for narrative blocks. Strict UTF-8 encoding, no trailing whitespace, consistent 2-space indentation for lists, and fenced code blocks labeled exactly 'mermaid'. Violations of heading hierarchy or formatting rules cause failure.

criteria.name: Viewport & Layout Constraint
criteria.description: When rendered via standard mermaid-cli at 100% scale, the diagram must fit within a 1200px width without clipping or requiring horizontal scroll. Node count must be ≤ 25 and edge count ≤ 40. Overlapping bounding boxes or broken layout directives cause failure.

criteria.name: Bi-Directional Node-Narrative Consistency
criteria.description: Zero-tolerance cross-verification required: every mermaid node ID must appear verbatim in the narrative section, and every narrative container must have a corresponding mermaid node. Mismatches, orphaned nodes, or narrative sections without diagram representations cause failure.
